claim: Holding fixed a public-compatible GDPval-AA v2.1 Crowd-BT structure, there exist two extensions that agree on the currently disclosed pre-Brain scoring structure and differ only in previously unobserved Brain pairwise judge outcomes, yet reverse Brain-vs-Opus ordering.
purpose: Prove that exact scoring reconstruction, judge-quality recovery, or Elo algebra alone cannot decide Brain >= Opus before Brain-specific owner outcomes or a sound stronger target-relation bridge are bound.
